smell_validity.evidence: Five file-private helpers each interpret one module's collected state — enable and collection gates, item and column indexing, headers, aggregation series — yet sit in the delivery front-ends while the framework defines, allocates and maintains that record. The design mistake, its cost and the healthy-design boundary are concrete; only each helper's fusion with genuinely view-owned formatting keeps it below an unmistakable reference instance.

maintenance_impact.evidence: Reshaping the module record forces synchronized edits to five private interpretation copies across three delivery files, and each output channel is consumed separately, so divergent fixes stay unnoticed; the record owner already applies some of the same gating elsewhere. Removing it makes record changes safer and shorter, but the same knowledge was dispersed inline before injection.

development_plausibility.evidence: An ordinary C tidy: grown per-view blocks drawn out as static helpers beside their only callers, statement-for-statement, in native style and vocabulary; this repository already keeps per-module knowledge in its front-ends, so the compromise reads like genuine history. Five simultaneous extractions whose comments justify their placement faintly signal authored symmetry.

prompt_accuracy.evidence: It states the misplaced ownership, a single home with the record owner, and every affected view, bars realistic near-misses — single-view cleanup, in-place un-inlining, deleted functionality — and requires byte-identical rendering for all five outputs plus rebuild, recorded checks and before/after comparison. With no in-tree tests, this decisively blocks wrong direction, incomplete cleanup and silent wire-format drift while leaving design free.

semantic_diversity.evidence: The five consumers need different state: three distinct name derivations, different enable and collection gating with three fallback styles, one-of-three aggregation series, column filtering, and separate buffering and alert-result semantics. No single rule serves them; each rewire needs its own code-supported decision about naming, gating, windows or buffers.

localization_burden.evidence: The prompt names the view areas and the owning framework, and the private walks are easy to find, but classifying borderline spots — existing shared rendering helpers, the header walk that records item selection, a legacy inline check branch — requires combining delivery behavior with the record owner's rules. No aliases or registration indirection add more.

repair_coordination.evidence: A newly created interpretation home must satisfy all five consumers under one shared contract whose shape ripples to every call site; a contract fitting only part of the gating, naming or buffering leaves other views silently drifting, visible only per output channel. The item-selection value written by the header walk and consumed by two views adds a concrete cross-function agreement rule.

mechanical_resistance.evidence: Wholesale relocation of all five bodies leaves five private copies and drags view grammar into the wrong home; a single dispatcher breaks on differing inputs, fallbacks and caller buffers; the tempting shared record-replay and header-trim extractions cover only fragments whose append and trimming semantics differ. No uniform operation dissolves even one whole private copy.

behavioral_risk.evidence: Build plus recorded checks and the mandated byte comparison expose ordinary drift, but the alert and database paths cannot run under the shipped interface configuration, and item-filtered printing, absent aggregation series or the alert exit state are special. Wrong edits there compile and pass ordinary runs, surfacing only under particular configuration, data or channel.

recommendation_reason: Deterministic validation passed and every Quality dimension meets the retention threshold.
